column1: # tools/controls/controls.tsv -- the negative controls (STANDARD.md, "A gate nobody has seen go red";
# tools/luaurun -controls). One control per line: name, the src file, the needle (which must occur
# exactly once in that file) and its replacement, TAB separated. Each deletes ONE refusal rule from a
# copy of the unit, and the conformance corpus run against it must fail exactly the vectors of
# conformance-controls/<name>.expected. unknown-operation patches nothing: it adds
# conformance-controls/unknown-operation.txt to the corpus, whose one vector must fail.
# Carried: every control the reference names except ranged-reconstruction and ranged-range, whose
# .expected lists assume the C++ structure (int_relative's bounded tiers and the string length read
# through serialize_int); this port reads those tiers and that length in their own family, so a
# one-line deletion in serialize_int cannot reach them. Both rules stay covered: the int family's
# own tests and the corpus vectors that pin them run in every ordinary run.
